content: {"episode_id":"ep-05062","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration of the denial for CPT 93271 is requested based on the documented recurrent episodes of palpitations and sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia. The supplied clinical indication note does not document that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate."}
